item.description:
Draft and Prompt are beta. They rewrite with the local model, and in testing it changes the meaning of roughly one dictation in twelve — not often, but not rarely enough to insert unread. Read what they give you before you send it. Clean is the one to trust without looking.

Prompt refuses less and keeps your questions. It is now told, first, that the message is not addressed to it — so a dictated question comes back as a question instead of an answer. Its checks also catch a named thing or a "who said it" going missing, and an example that once leaked three plumbing steps into a dictation is gone.

Clean, Draft and Prompt are spelled as names however you say them.
